**用户：**
可以，优雅的质感。我感觉这个光标的边框好像有点太亮了，能不能降低点透明度？

**AI：**
<think>The user wants to reduce the opacity/brightness of the cursor highlight border. Currently it uses `var(--accent)` which is `#00d4ff`. I need to change the1px borders (top/bottom/right) to use a lower opacity version. The left3px border should probably stay the same or also be dimmed.

Let me check what `--accent` is defined as.

From the CSS I saw earlier: `--accent:#00d4ff`

So `var(--accent)` is `#00d4ff` which is fully opaque. The user wants to reduce the brightness. I should use an rgba version with lower opacity.

Let me change the1px borders to use a semi-transparent version, like `rgba(0,212,255,0.4)` or something. And maybe the left3px border too.

Actually, let me just ask... no, the user said the border is too bright. Let me reduce opacity on the borders. I'll use rgba with lower alpha.</think>
<tool_LRcc name="package_proxy">
  <param name="params">{"command": "sed -n '17,25p' /root/kfmv4/public/css/sidebar.css"}</param>
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
</tool_LRcc><tool_result_XOuY name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":".cursor-highlight{\n  position:absolute;\n  height:32px;\n  background:rgba(46,213,163,.15);\n  border-left:3px solid var(--accent);border-top:1px solid var(--accent);border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent);border-right:1px solid var(--accent);\n  border-radius:4px;\n  z-index:1050;\n  pointer-events:none;\n  transition:top .3s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94),left .3s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94),width .3s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94);","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_XOuY>
`var(--accent)` 是 `#00d4ff`，完全不透明。给上/下/右细线降到 0.4 透明度：
<tool_ME1i name="package_proxy">
  <param name="params">{"command": "sed -i 's/border-top:1px solid var(--accent);border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent);border-right:1px solid var(--accent)/border-top:1px solid rgba(0,212,255,.4);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,212,255,.4);border-right:1px solid rgba(0,212,255,.4)/' /root/kfmv4/public/css/sidebar.css && cd /root/kfmv4 && pkill -f 'node dist/server' 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; nohup node dist/server/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 0.5 && git add -A && git commit -m 'style: cursor highlight top/bottom/right border reduce opacity to 0.4'"}</param>
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
</tool_ME1i><tool_result_oeTM name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":"[detached HEAD 3ec318d] style: cursor highlight top/bottom/right border reduce opacity to 0.4\n 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_oeTM>
上/下/右细线降到 `rgba(0,212,255,0.4)`，左侧 3px 粗线保持原色不变。洛，刷新看看手感。
